image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a stack of audio cassette tapes. The primary subject is a black cassette tape in the foreground with a white label featuring handwritten text and blue marker lines. Behind it are other cassettes, including one with a green label on the left spine and another black one above. The image has a shallow depth of field, with the background blurring out.
